title: Walk through it in this order

steps.heading: Clarify the rules
steps.body: Ask which vehicles and parking spaces are supported, how payment works, and whether there are multiple floors or gates. Confirm what is outside the problem.

steps.heading: List the main objects
steps.body: Start with ParkingLot, Floor, Spot, Vehicle, Ticket, and Payment. A spot can have a size such as compact, regular, or large.

steps.heading: Show how they connect
steps.body: A parking lot contains floors. Each floor contains spaces. A ticket records which vehicle is using which space.

steps.heading: Choose a design only when it helps
steps.body: Use a separate pricing rule if prices can change. Use a vehicle creator if vehicle setup has different rules. Pass the shared parking lot to the objects that need it.

steps.heading: Check unusual cases
steps.body: Think about a full lot, a lost ticket, two cars arriving at once, and spaces reserved for electric vehicles.
